latestVersion.changelog:
Academic Writing Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release offering specialized support for academic writing, including scholarly papers, literature reviews, research methodology, and thesis writing.
- All outputs are produced in Markdown and encapsulated within <ama-doc></ama-doc> tags for clarity.
- Strict adherence to academic integrity: only real, verifiable academic sources are cited; prohibited sources (e.g., blogs, Wikipedia, news) are excluded.
- Clear citation and reference list formatting requirements, emphasizing numbered in-text citations and a standardized "References" section.
- Comprehensive content structuring guidelines provided, including formal tone, technical precision, and explicit inclusion of diagrams or tables when appropriate.
- Ensures language alignment with user queries and maintains consistency throughout the document.
